supported_scope: Inspecting and exporting tool calls, commands, results, and changes associated with a task via streaming JSON output and interactive CLI commands
unestablished_scope: Explicit retention policies for action logs
Integrity guarantees of audit trail data
Distinction and export of chat history separate from audit trail
required_setup: Use --output-format stream-json to emit NDJSON events capturing tool calls and results; use /agents to monitor subagent logs and status; use /diff to review changes; configure toolPermission and artifactReviewPolicy for tool execution control
constraints: Audit trail is accessible via streaming JSON output and CLI commands but retention and integrity guarantees are not explicitly documented
Tool calls requiring authorization prompt inline approval in /agents panel
Context compaction via checkpoints may summarize older turns, affecting full history visibility

evidence.section: Headless mode > Output formats > Streaming JSON > Tool calls in the stream
evidence.quote: On tool steps, tool_info carries the call and its result. This is a real tool step from a run that executed echo hello_headless_demo
evidence.claim: Tool calls and their results are recorded in streaming JSON output as part of the run

evidence.section: Headless mode > Output formats > Streaming JSON
evidence.quote: Set --output-format stream-json to emit one JSON object per line (NDJSON) as the run progresses. Use this format to observe tool calls and token usage in real time.
evidence.claim: Streaming JSON output format provides real-time monitoring of tool calls and results

evidence.section: Agents command (/agents) > Subagent monitoring and control > Inspecting subagent progress
evidence.quote: This view displays the subagent’s complete internal thoughts, tool calls, and execution stdout.
evidence.claim: Subagent detail view in /agents command shows detailed logs including tool calls and execution output

evidence.quote: The /diff command opens the Interactive Diff Viewer, a full-screen panel that allows you to inspect changes in your workspace and conversation history.
evidence.claim: The /diff command supports inspection of changes associated with tasks
